statement.latest: \dot I_s=T_s-2\nu s I_s+F_s,\qquad \sum_s T_s=0\text{ in the unforced closed finite Galerkin system}
statement.note_ascii: shell energy separates nonlinear redistribution T_s from viscous dissipation; total nonlinear transfer cancels across retained shells

coq.verified: 2026-09-11, this task: coqc -q clean compile + independent Print Assumptions scratch check on all three theorems.
coq.honest_caveats: Mechanizes exactly the combinatorial step the proposal's own how_to_check names: for an ABSTRACT pairwise shell-to-shell transfer coefficient X(s,s') satisfying the antisymmetry X(s,s')=-X(s',s) (the shell-coarsened image of the per-triad convective-coupling antisymmetry C(k;p,q)=-C(p;k,q) the proposal cites), the total double sum sum_s sum_s' X(s,s') is exactly 0, by finite double-sum exchange (proved by induction) plus S=-S => S=0 in Q; and the balance equation itself is proved as the pure algebraic identity it is by construction (T_s defined as Idot_s+2 nu s I_s-F_s). NOT mechanized: deriving the antisymmetry hypothesis X(s,s')=-X(s',s) from the actual Navier-Stokes convective term / incompressible pressure projection acting on a concrete finite Fourier-Galerkin triad set K_N (i.e. going from the cited exact fact sum_k u_k.(u.grad u)_k=0 to a specific triad-indexed C(k;p,q) and then to shell-grouped X), and NOT mechanized as a literal three-index (k,p,q) triad construction -- the pairwise shell-flux X(s,s') formalization is a standard, mathematically equivalent coarsening but is a strictly smaller mechanization than the literal wavevector-triad statement. TIER FIX (this task): this copy previously read tier=Definition, which mismatched the extensions.json copy's tier=Dr for the same proposal id; Dr is correct since sum_s T_s=0 is a real conservation claim requiring the antisymmetry input, not a naming convention needing no proof -- fixed here to Dr to match. Tier left at Dr (not upgraded to Th_coqc) because the physical antisymmetry premise is assumed, not derived, in the mechanization.

honest_caveats: The registered statement bundles two layers: (a) an EXACT-IDENTITY layer -- int T_s dt = I_s(t1) - I_s(t0) + 2 nu s int I_s dt - int F_s dt, which is the fundamental theorem of calculus applied to PROP-NSOBS-09's continuum ODE d I_s/dt = T_s - 2 nu s I_s + F_s; and (b) a RADIUS-COMPOSITION layer -- that the same affine combination, applied to independently-radius-certified reported quantities, has output radius bounded by r_1+r_0+2 nu s r_I+r_F via the triangle inequality.

coq/canonical/PROP_EPSC_21_window_transfer_certificate.v mechanizes ONLY layer (b), axiom-free: for arbitrary rational 'reported' and 'true' values of I_s(t1), I_s(t0), int I_s dt, int F_s dt with arbitrary certified rational error radii r_1, r_0, r_I, r_F, and the transfer-window quantity DEFINED (per layer (a)) as the same affine combination of either the reported or the true inputs, Qabs(Tint_reported - Tint_true) <= r_1 + r_0 + Qabs(coeff)*r_I + r_F is proved from the triangle inequality alone -- no PDE/manifold content, matching the proposal's own how_to_check note that this half is 'completely generic'.

Layer (a) -- the FTC step itself, i.e. that int T_s dt for an ACTUAL continuum time integral equals that affine combination -- is NOT mechanized: it needs Coq.Reals/Coquelicot real-analysis integral/derivative machinery this repo does not have applied to PROP-NSOBS-09's ODE, and PROP-NSOBS-09 itself is not yet Coq-mechanized (coq_status open_prop at time of writing). It is instead taken in the .v file as a defining identity for the abstract quantity Tint (an explicit Definition, applied identically to reported and true inputs), exactly as the source states it -- cited, not re-derived from an actual integral.

Tier is left at Dr (not raised to Th_coqc) and status left at unverified because the FULL registered claim (exact identity + radius bound) is not yet mechanized end-to-end -- only the generic radius-composition sub-result is now Coq-verified, axiom-free. A separate tracked item would need to mechanize PROP-NSOBS-09's ODE and its FTC integration in Coq.Reals/Coquelicot before layer (a) can be closed the same way.
claim_boundary: Partial EPSC-19 closure only. A certified map from noisy window observations to a full quotient-state radius rho_N is still required before end-to-end measurement-to-continuum certification.
